news.headline: DCTH shares hit a new 52-week high near $17.42
news.summary: Delcath shares traded as high as $17.42 intraday on August 14, 2026, extending the rally that began after the company's Q2 earnings beat and raised guidance. Volume was elevated at roughly 1.2 million shares.

news.headline: Delcath presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Delcath management participated in the Canaccord Genuity Growth Conference in Boston on August 11, 2026, presenting its commercial progress and pipeline to institutional investors. The appearance followed closely on the heels of the company's strong Q2 print.

news.headline: Sell-side analysts raise price targets after Q2 beat
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright raised its price target to $32 from $30, BTIG to $21 from $17, and Craig-Hallum to $21 from $18, all reiterating Buy ratings after Delcath's Q2 revenue beat and raised full-year guidance. Consensus rating remains Strong Buy with an average target near $21.

news.headline: Delcath reports Q2 2026 results and raises FY2026 revenue guidance to $104-108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose 20% year-over-year to $29.1 million, beating consensus of $26.6 million, with HEPZATO KIT revenue of $27.1 million (up 21%) and gross margin expanding to 90%. Delcath raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104-108 million (implying at least 28% HEPZATO volume growth) and now expects positive adjusted EBITDA, while active treatment centers grew to 31 with a target of 37 by year-end.

news.headline: Delcath highlights new retrospective data on HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer
news.summary: In its Q2 business update, Delcath highlighted independent investigator data from ESMO Breast Cancer showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate (9 of 15 patients) with percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer patients. The data reinforce the rationale behind the company's ongoing randomized DELUMA Phase 2 trial in the same population.

news.headline: First patient dosed in DELUMA Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO in metastatic breast cancer
news.summary: Delcath dosed the first patient at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in its global, randomized DELUMA Phase 2 trial testing HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer. The trial plans to enroll roughly 90 patients across more than 20 sites in the US and Europe, targeting a population of about 7,000 US patients annually.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Delcath has historically reported Q3 results in early November (Q3 2025 was reported November 4, 2025); no confirmed date yet for Q3 2026.

catalysts.label: Target of 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers by year-end
catalysts.detail: Management guided to roughly six additional center activations in H2 2026, bringing the active network from 31 to about 37 sites, a key driver of continued HEPZATO KIT volume growth.

catalysts.label: FY2026 revenue guidance of $104M-$108M
catalysts.detail: Raised guidance implies at least 28% HEPZATO KIT volume growth over 2025 with positive adjusted EBITDA for the year; year-end results will show whether the range is met.

catalysts.label: DELUMA (metastatic breast cancer) and mCRC Phase 2 hepatic PFS readouts
catalysts.detail: Primary endpoint (hepatic progression-free survival) data from the randomized Phase 2 trials of HEPZATO in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (DELUMA) and metastatic colorectal cancer are anticipated around mid-2028, with overall survival data later in 2028.

pulse: Delcath is executing well on its commercial ramp: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M beat estimates, HEPZATO KIT sales grew 21% YoY on 90%-plus gross margins, and management raised FY2026 guidance to $104-108M while guiding toward 37 active treatment centers by year-end. The print and raised outlook triggered a wave of price-target increases from H.C. Wainwright, BTIG, and Craig-Hallum, and the stock pushed to a fresh 52-week high in mid-August. With commercial momentum intact, the next catalysts to watch are continued center activations toward the 37-site target, Q3 2026 results likely in early November, and early progress in the newly dosed DELUMA breast-cancer and colorectal-cancer Phase 2 label-expansion trials.
